title: Embarrassed to go to the doctor?
speaker: BBC Learning English

keywords.def: put off to a later time; postpone
identify a disease or medical problem by recognising the symptoms and examining the patient
endure or struggle with painful feelings or trauma without asking anyone for help
make someone feel calm and relaxed
kept private and secret; information which is not shared with anyone
communication using means such as the expression on your face, hand gestures, or tone of voice to show how you feel about something, rather than using words

sentences.en: Hello. This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 您好。这里是BBC英语教学的《6分钟英语》。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Beth. Lots of things can make us feel embarrassed – that self-conscious, uncomfortable feeling when your face blushes red and you wish you could just disappear.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔。我是贝斯。许多事情都会让我们感到尴尬——那种自我意识过强、浑身不自在的感觉，当你的脸涨得通红，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。

sentences.en: Have you had any embarrassing moments, Neil?
sentences.zh: 尼尔，你有过什么尴尬的时刻吗？

sentences.en: Yes, many. Once I met my parents in a car park and I saw them arriving in their car and I waved my hands around in a very silly way.
sentences.zh: 有啊，很多次。有一次我在停车场接我父母，我看到他们的车开过来，就用一种很滑稽的方式挥舞着双臂。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, I soon discovered that it wasn't my parents.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，我很快发现那根本不是我父母。

sentences.en: It was another couple. Oh no, that's really embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 是另一对情侣。哦天哪，那真的太尴尬了。

sentences.en: I remember answering the phone, I thought it was my best friend and I said "hello" in a very silly voice, and then they asked to speak to my dad, and it wasn't my friend.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次接电话，我以为是我最好的朋友，就用一种很滑稽的语气说了一声“哈喽”，结果对方要求跟我爸爸讲话，那根本不是我朋友。

sentences.en: What was the voice? Hello? Oh dear. But embarrassment is more than just shyness and blushing.
sentences.zh: 那是怎样的语气？哈喽？哦天哪。但尴尬不仅仅是害羞和脸红。

sentences.en: When it comes to our health, there's no end of things to be embarrassed about.
sentences.zh: 说到我们的健康，让人感到尴尬的事情可以说是数不胜数。

sentences.en: Yes, and some people feel so embarrassed that they don’t go to see a doctor when they should, sometimes with serious consequences.
sentences.zh: 是的，有些人感到太尴尬了，以至于该去看医生的时候却不敢去，有时还会带来严重的后果。

sentences.en: In this programme, we'll be discussing the issue of medical embarrassment, and as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将讨论看病时的尴尬这一问题，而且像往常一样，我们会学到一些实用的新单词和短语。

sentences.en: So, I have a question. Neil, according to the UK's Nursing Times newspaper, what percentage of people surveyed said they had delayed visiting their doctor out of embarrassment, and then later been diagnosed with a health condition?
sentences.zh: 所以，我有一个问题。尼尔，根据英国《护理时报》的报道，受访者中有多少比例的人表示，他们因为感到尴尬而耽误了去看医生，后来却被诊断出患有某种健康状况？

sentences.en: Was it: a) 21%? b) 41%? or, c) 61%? So I think it's probably a lot.
sentences.zh: 是：a) 21%？b) 41%？还是 c) 61%？所以我觉得这个比例可能很高。

sentences.en: So c) 61%. OK. We will find out if that's correct at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 那我选 c) 61%。好的。我们将在节目结束时揭晓答案是否正确。

sentences.en: As humans we get embarrassed if we feel different from others, especially if the difference is physical.
sentences.zh: 作为人类，如果我们觉得自己和别人不一样，尤其是这种差异体现在身体上时，我们就会感到尴尬。

sentences.en: But how does feeling embarrassed about a medical condition impact our relationship with the doctor?
sentences.zh: 但是，对某种健康状况感到尴尬，是如何影响我们与医生的关系的呢？

sentences.en: Here's Dr Vanessa Apea, consultant in sexual health at Barts Hospital in London, explaining more to BBC Radio 4 programme, Inside Health: So they'll delay accessing the clinic, and also seeking treatment, and so then you'll often see people that could have been diagnosed with what's happening much earlier, and could have had earlier intervention, but it's delayed quite significantly.
sentences.zh: 这是伦敦巴茨医院性健康顾问瓦妮莎·阿佩阿博士，在向BBC广播四台的节目《走进健康》做出的进一步解释：所以他们会耽误去诊所的时间，也会延误寻求治疗，所以你经常会看到一些人，他们本可以在更早的时候被诊断出病情，并获得早期的干预，但却被严重延误了。

sentences.en: And so I then feel that we see a lot of people kind of suffering in silence really.
sentences.zh: 因此，我觉得我们看到很多人其实都在默默承受着痛苦。

sentences.en: Many people delay going to the doctor – they postpone going or put it off until a later time.
sentences.zh: 许多人耽误了去看医生——他们推迟就医或把时间往后拖。

sentences.en: As a result, their problem isn’t diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 结果，他们的问题就没有被诊断出来。

sentences.en: To diagnose means to identify a disease or health problem through medical examination.
sentences.zh: 诊断的意思是通过医学检查来确定疾病或健康问题。

sentences.en: For some, feelings of embarrassment are so strong they prefer to suffer in silence – to struggle with pain without seeking help - rather than visit the doctor.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，尴尬的情绪如此强烈，以至于他们宁愿默默忍受痛苦——在不寻求帮助的情况下与病痛抗争——也不愿去看医生。

sentences.en: But fortunately, there are things you can do to help.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，你可以采取一些措施来缓解这种情况。

sentences.en: Writing your problem down, going with a friend, and visiting a doctor you trust are some ideas Dr Apea recommends.
sentences.zh: 把你的问题写下来、找个朋友陪着去、以及去看一个你信任的医生，这些都是阿佩阿博士推荐的方法。

sentences.en: There are ways that doctors can help as well, as Dr Vanessa Apea explains here to James Gallagher, presenter of BBC Radio 4 programme, Inside Health: Can you tell us what techniques you use to put people at ease?
sentences.zh: 医生也有办法提供帮助，正如瓦妮莎·阿佩阿博士在这里向BBC广播四台《走进健康》节目的主持人詹姆斯·加拉格尔所解释的那样：你能告诉我们你用什么技巧来让人们放松吗？

sentences.en: I bring transparency to the conversation, and own it, and say that I'm going to be asking you some quite personal questions, and there may be also intimate examination… I want to assure you that this is confidential, that this is a safe, non-judgmental space…
sentences.zh: 我在谈话中会保持透明，主动承担，并告诉对方我接下来要问一些相当私人的问题，可能还会有一些比较私密的检查……我想向你保证这是保密的，这是一个安全、不带评判的空间……

sentences.en: So really, I often name the words to create that space as well.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我经常会把这些话说出口，以此来营造那样的氛围。

sentences.en: Also in my manner, I would hope, and in my non-verbal cues.
sentences.zh: 另外我也希望通过我的态度以及我的非言语线索来做到这一点。

sentences.en: James asks what doctors can do to put people at ease – to make them feel calm and relaxed - and Dr Apea describes her ideal conversation: it’s a safe space, it’s non-judgmental and what is said is confidential, kept private and not shared with anyone.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯问医生能做些什么来让人们安心——让他们感到平静和放松——阿佩阿博士描述了她理想中的对话：这是一个安全的空间，不带评判色彩，而且所说的话是保密的，属于私密内容，不会与任何人分享。

sentences.en: As well as discussing embarrassing problems sensitively, Dr Apea also uses non-verbal cues - the expression on her face, her hand movements, and the tone of her voice, rather than words, to communicate and relax the patient.
sentences.zh: 除了敏感地讨论尴尬的问题外，阿佩阿博士还会使用非言语线索——比如她脸上的表情、手势和说话的语调，而不是仅仅通过言语，来与病人沟通并让他们放松。

sentences.en: Embarrassment is normal, and with support hopefully more of us will feel safe to visit the doctor despite it.
sentences.zh: 尴尬是正常的，在获得支持的情况下，希望我们当中能有更多人在面对尴尬时，依然能感到安全并前往就医。

sentences.en: OK, Beth, isn't it time to reveal the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 好了，贝斯，是不是该公布你那个问题的答案了？

sentences.en: It is. I asked you: What percentage of people said they had delayed visiting the doctor because they were embarrassed, but then had later been diagnosed with a health condition?
sentences.zh: 是的。我问过你：有多少比例的人表示，他们因为感到尴尬而耽误了去看医生，但后来却被诊断出患有某种健康状况？

sentences.en: Do you remember what you said, Neil? Yes, I think I said c) 61%.
sentences.zh: 你还记得你选了什么吗，尼尔？记得，我想我选的是 c) 61%。

sentences.en: I'm afraid that is not the correct answer!
sentences.zh: 恐怕这不是正确答案！

sentences.en: It was, in fact a) 21% or just over a fifth.
sentences.zh: 事实上是 a) 21%，或者说刚过五分之一。

sentences.en: OK, let’s recap the new vocabulary we've used, starting with delay, to postpone or put off until a later time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们回顾一下今天学过的新词汇，首先是 delay（耽误），意思是推迟或延后到以后再做。

sentences.en: To diagnose a disease or medical condition means to identify it by recognising the symptoms and examining the patient.
sentences.zh: Diagnose（诊断）一种疾病或健康状况，意味着通过识别症状和检查患者来确定病情。

sentences.en: If you suffer in silence, you endure and struggle with painful feelings without asking someone for help.
sentences.zh: 如果你 suffer in silence（默默承受痛苦），你就是在忍受和挣扎于痛苦的情绪中，却不向任何人寻求帮助。

sentences.en: The phrasal verb put someone at ease means to make someone feel calm and relaxed.
sentences.zh: 动词短语 put someone at ease 的意思是让某人感到平静和放松。

sentences.en: The adjective confidential means kept private and secret and describes information which is not shared with anyone else.
sentences.zh: 形容词 confidential 的意思是保密的、机密的，用来描述不与其他人分享的信息。

sentences.en: And finally, non-verbal cues are types of communication using facial expressions, hand gestures or tone of voice, rather than speech, to show your feelings.
sentences.zh: 最后，non-verbal cues（非言语线索）是指使用面部表情、手势或语调而不是言语来进行沟通，以表达你感受的交流方式。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but why not built your vocabulary and listening skills even more with the quiz and worksheet related to this programme?
sentences.zh: 我们的6分钟时间又到了，不过为什么不通过本期节目的相关测验和练习题来进一步提升你的词汇量和听力技能呢？

sentences.en: They’re both available now on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 它们现在都可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到。

sentences.en: See you there! Bye!
sentences.zh: 到时候见！再见！
